remarks: BACKING ONTO GREEN SPACE | TRIPLE GARAGE | 5 BEDROOMS | 4 FULL BATHS | SPICE KITCHEN Luxury meets functionality in this stunning 2,625 sq. ft. home with a triple attached garage on an expansive lot. Backing onto green space, this thoughtfully designed residence features upscale finishes, elegant feature ceilings and designer walls throughout. The main floor offers a bedroom and full bath, ideal for guests or multi-generational living, plus an open-concept living area, chef-inspired kitchen with premium cabinetry and a separate spice kitchen. Upstairs, the spacious primary retreat boasts a spa-inspired ensuite. Two additional bedrooms share a convenient Jack & Jill bathroom, while a fourth upper-floor bedroom has access to another full bathroom.Combining thoughtful design, premium finishes and a desirable green-space setting, this home is designed to impress! Photos are from a similar property built by the same builder. Finishes, layout, and features may vary. Some images are virtually staged. (id:67522)
